hadith_en: Ibn `Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), upon returning from Hajj, entered Madinah and  made his camel kneel at the entrance of his Mosque. He then entered and offered two Rak`ahs, after which he proceeded to his home..
syarah_en: Traveling has its etiquettes, which the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) was keen to observe and consistently upheld. A Muslim should strive to follow these etiquettes and take the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as an example in practicing them.In this Hadith, `Abdullah ibn `Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), "upon returning" meaning, when he arrived in Madinah "from Hajj," referring to the Farewell Hajj, "entered Madinah and made his camel kneel" that is, he caused it to sit "at the entrance of his Mosque," referring to the Prophet’s Mosque. "He then entered and prayed two Rak`ahs”, meaning, he offered two Rak`ahs upon his arrival from travel, and then “he proceeded to his home.".
